stream.why: In streaming mode a cut-off SSE stream raises pydantic_ai.exceptions.ModelAPIError (Connection error.) and is not retried; non-streaming requests are retried and PASS.

mixed-content.why: Chat Completions tool results cannot carry images; Pydantic AI moves the image elsewhere in the request (outside the tool message).

embedded-resource.why: Not representable; Pydantic AI drops both embedded resources (text blocks arrive unchanged).

resource-link.why: Not representable; Pydantic AI includes the resource_link (its URI) inside the tool text.

audio-content.why: Not representable; Pydantic AI moves the audio elsewhere in the request (outside the tool message).
